fullData.title: Counting Starry Bears
fullData.description: Practicing counting bears in sequence from eleven to twenty.

challenges.instruction: Can you count all the bears arranged in a circle?
challenges.hint: Try tapping each bear one at a time and watch the numbers appear.
challenges.narration: Let's start our journey by counting these lovely bears in a circle!

challenges.instruction: Touch each bear in the line to find out how many there are.
challenges.hint: Go slowly from left to right so you don't miss any.
challenges.narration: Here they are lined up neatly for you. Let's count them all.

challenges.instruction: Can you count all the scattered bears?
challenges.hint: Take your time and tap every single bear to track your count.
challenges.narration: These bears are playing around! Can you count them all?

challenges.instruction: Count the bears in this new line.
challenges.hint: Tap each one gently to make sure you get the right total.
challenges.narration: Another row of friendly bears waiting to be counted!

challenges.instruction: Look at these clustered bears. Can you count them all?
challenges.hint: Count the bears in one little group before moving to the next.
challenges.narration: They are hanging out in friendly groups. Let's count them together.

challenges.instruction: Count the bears as they form this lovely line.
challenges.hint: Keep going! You are doing a wonderful job keeping track.
challenges.narration: We are getting higher! Let's count this longer line of bears.

challenges.instruction: Can you count all the bears?
challenges.hint: Tap each bear carefully to reach the very last one.
challenges.narration: This is our final challenge with all twenty bears! You can do it!
